svg.title: G1 Port Audit: what stops each policy
svg.desc: Mean survival on the teleop-walking-benchmark tour (out of 90 s) at each stage, for 30 ported G1 policies, with the cause gaitkeeper names; and gaitkeeper survival against the benchmark.
svg.text: Mean survival (s of 90) on the benchmark tour, one change at a time
Dashed: stage not run (no upstream config read, or the policy lists no arms). Full results: dundysm.github.io/gaitkeeper/results
